title: Koh Young Technology
description: [AI generated] Koh Young Technology is a South Korean company specializing in 3D inspection and measurement solutions for the electronics manufacturing industry. Founded in 2002 and headquartered in Seoul, South Korea, it is known for developing Solder Paste Inspection (SPI) and Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) systems used in surface mount technology (SMT) production lines. The company also expands into medical robotics, serving semiconductor and electronics sectors globally.
